plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instructions for selecting the 'Developers' dropdown relied on positional CSS selectors (`div:nth-of-type(2) > button`) that broke when the header navigation structure changed. As a result, the cached instructions clicked the 'Solutions' dropdown instead, causing the test to navigate to `https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/` and fail the URL equality assertion. Live screenshots confirm that 'Developers' remains present in the header.
observedIndicators: Cached page.ai instruction replayed a positional selector (`div:nth-of-type(2) > button`) that targeted the 'Solutions' button instead of 'Developers'.
Live failure screenshot shows the 'Developers' dropdown is still present on the checklyhq.com navigation bar.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached page.ai instructions for checkly.test.ts to force re-evaluation of the live navigation header.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache will allow the agent to inspect the current DOM structure and generate fresh selectors targeting 'Developers' -> 'Documentation'.
